## Testing & Evidence

<!-- All items are required before requesting review. -->

- [ ] **Affected pages list**: I've documented which routes/views this PR touches.
- [ ] **Tests added**: I've added or updated automated tests that cover the change.
- [ ] **Screenshots / recordings**: I've attached visual evidence showing the change works as expected.
- [ ] **Commands run**: I've listed any setup, seed, or migration commands executed during testing.
- [ ] **CI status**: CI is passing on this branch (green check on the latest commit).
